name: garmin-connector
description: Personal Claude connector for Garmin Connect, using Garmin's official Personal API.

scripts.setup: wrangler login && wrangler deploy && wrangler secret put GARMIN_API_KEY && wrangler secret put OWNER_PASSPHRASE

GARMIN_API_KEY.description: Your Garmin Connect Personal API key. Create one in Garmin Connect under Settings > Personal API.

OWNER_PASSPHRASE.description: A passphrase of at least 16 characters (for example four unrelated words). You type it once when you connect Claude.

OAUTH_KV.description: Storage for sign-in records. Created automatically.
